currency.label: Goals above replacement
currency.desc: Our value model: goals created above a replacement-level player of the same position (Hockey-Reference's goals-created split of the team's goals), a damped share of +/- relative to the team, penalties and faceoffs; goalies: goals saved above average, shrunk toward average on few shots. Six goals are about one win.
